=== README compat ===
5:Generic multi-provider adapter for the harness LLM seam backed by [`@earendil-works/pi-ai`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-ai). One plugin instance owns a dict of provider profiles keyed by route; every request selects a profile with `GenerateOptions.provider` and resolves `GenerateOptions.model` against that route's configured catalog. A route naming an installed pi-ai provider inherits its endpoint, wire protocol, and model catalog as defaults and overrides them field by field; a route pi-ai does not ship is declared outright, so an OpenAI-compatible gateway, a self-hosted server, or a provider newer than the installed catalog is configuration rather than a code change.
55:        compat:
56:          thinkingFormat: deepseek
78:A profile's `models` list *replaces* the route's installed catalog rather than extending it; omitting it (or leaving it empty) serves that catalog unchanged. Each entry defaults its unset fields from the installed model of the same `id`, so narrowing a catalog route to two models, correcting one capacity, or adding a model newer than the installed catalog are all one-line edits — but declaring any `models` list means every model the route should keep serving must appear in it, an entry of nothing but `id` being enough. The configurable entry fields are `id`, `name`, `contextWindow`, `maxTokens`, `reasoningEfforts`, and `compat`. Pricing and input modalities have no harness consumer and ride the installed entry or are absent.
80:`modelOverrides` reshapes individual installed-catalog models without that cost: each key is a catalog model id, each value the same fields a `models` entry takes with the id living in the key, and the rest of the catalog keeps serving untouched — "correct one model, keep the other thirty-seven" as a three-line edit. An override becomes that catalog entry's configuration, so capacities, efforts, and compat resolve through the same path with the same diagnostics and the same request-default semantics as a `models` entry. Overrides are only meaningful on a catalog route serving its catalog: one set beside a `models` list (which already replaces the catalog), on a hand-declared route (whose models are fully spelled in `models`), or naming a model the catalog does not describe is refused rather than skipped, because a silently unchanged model is a typo someone would otherwise hunt for.
88:### Reasoning-dispatch compat switches
90:How a thinking level travels — `reasoning_effort` alone, DeepSeek's `thinking: {type}` plus effort, z.ai's `thinking` object, and so on — is pi-ai's `compat.thinkingFormat`, which pi-ai guesses from the endpoint URL; a private gateway's URL says nothing, so a DeepSeek-dialect gateway would be spoken to in the OpenAI dialect with no way to correct it. `compat.thinkingFormat` and `compat.supportsReasoningEffort` are therefore configurable on the route (its models' default) and per model (winning per field), resolving model → route → installed catalog entry → pi-ai's URL-derived guess; setting a route-level switch shadows the catalog entry's value for every model on the route, and there is no spelling for handing a field back to the catalog short of restating its value. `thinkingFormat` accepts pi-ai's dispatchable formats except the two `chat-template` variants, which need `chatTemplateKwargs` this configuration does not expose. Both switches exist only on `openai-completions` — the other protocols carry their reasoning shape in the protocol itself — so a model-level switch elsewhere fails resolution, a route-level one skips models of other protocols, and a route with no `openai-completions` model at all is refused. The rest of pi-ai's compat surface (`supportsStore`, `maxTokensField`, …) stays auto-detected and is deliberately not configurable here.
116:Supported profile fields are `apiKeyEnv`, `displayName`, `api`, `baseURL`, `models`, `modelOverrides`, `compat`, `defaultContextWindow`, `defaultMaxTokens`, `defaultInput`, `headers`, `reasoning`, `thinkingBudgets`, `cacheRetention`, `transport`, `timeoutMs`, `websocketConnectTimeoutMs`, `streamIdleTimeoutMs`, and `retryPolicy`. Each profile's optional retry policy is captured with that provider route; omission uses bounded normal defaults. The stream-idle interval is a positive finite Node timer delay, defaults to five minutes, and covers only an outstanding provider read, not consumer think time. Harness app attribution wins a conflicting configured header name.

# DeepSeek loops on the OpenRouter bench route: prior-step reasoning never reaches the model

## Verdict

**Root cause: on this route the model's entire per-step deliberation lives in the `reasoning` channel, and nothing in that channel survives the round trip.** pi-ai serializes a prior step's thinking block as a plain `reasoning` string field on the assistant message; OpenRouter drops that field on input. The model therefore wakes at every step with its own tool calls and tool results but no memory of the plan that produced them, and restarts the investigation. `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731:free` puts ~100% of its narration in `reasoning` (its `content` is literally a single space), so it loses everything. `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free` on the same route emits **zero** reasoning blocks and narrates in `content`, which is replayed intact — which is why it writes and edits.

The defect is **fixable in this repository**: the harness's `PiAiCompatProfile` does not expose pi-ai's `compat.requiresThinkingAsText`, which is the switch that moves replayed reasoning into `content`. pi-ai itself is not broken — it is doing what an unconfigured `openai-completions` route says to do. The model is not broken either: given the identical history with the plan in `content`, it acts correctly on the first try.

Hypothesis 1 is **confirmed in substance but not in the form stated**: the harness does *not* drop a signature. `stream.ts` → `toPiReplayState` preserves `thinkingSignature` and `thoughtSignature` faithfully, and `replay.ts` → `replayedAssistant` restores them. The loss happens one layer up (pi-ai's ingest keeps only *encrypted* `reasoning_details`) and one layer down (OpenRouter ignores the `reasoning` field pi-ai re-sends).

---

## Evidence

### 1. Live, decisive: the reasoning channel is write-only (12 requests, `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731:free`)

Same three-message conversation each time; the assistant's prior turn "decided" the codeword `ZEBRA-7741`, placed in a different channel per variant; the user then asks for it back.

| # | prior turn carries the secret in | model's answer |
|---|---|---|
| A | `reasoning: "<text>"` (**exactly what pi-ai sends**) | `UNKNOWN` |
| B | `reasoning_details: [{type:"reasoning.text", …}]` (OpenRouter's documented replay form, echoed byte-for-byte from a real response) | `UNKNOWN` |
| C | `content: "<text>"` | `ZEBRA-7741` |
| D | nothing (negative control) | `UNKNOWN` |

**Only `content` reaches the model.** Neither field pi-ai can emit does.

### 2. Live, behavioral: the loop reproduces on one variable

Four-message agent conversation (harness-shaped system prompt, the csv-codec task, an assistant step whose plan is "I already read the spec; my very next action must be `write` on src/csv.js; I must not read those files again", a `read package.json` tool call, and its result). Only the channel of that plan differs.

| # | plan in | next action |
|---|---|---|
| X | `reasoning` (**what the harness sends today**) | `read {"file_path":"test/csv.test.js"}` ← **the bench loop, reproduced** |
| Y | `content` | `write {"file_path":"src/csv.js", "content":"export class CsvError extends Error {…"}` ← **correct** |
| V | `content` as an array `[{type:"text",…}]` (pi-ai's `requiresThinkingAsText` form) | `write` — correct, no block-structure mirroring |

Same model, same tools, same temperature/seed, same history bytes except the field name.

### 3. Session logs agree

`or-h2-free-t2/cell-Ze8JlA` (DeepSeek, `code:csv-codec`, 39 steps, 24 bash / 23 read / 0 write / 0 edit):

- Every assistant message carries a `reasoning` block with `replayState.blocks[i].thinkingSignature === "reasoning"`; **no** tool-call block ever carries a `thoughtSignature`.
- Text blocks are `" "` — a single space — on 16 of 39 steps and absent on the rest; only ~5 steps across the whole run have text that survives a `trim()`.
- The restarts are verbatim: step 1 "Let me start by exploring the workspace to understand the structure." → step 11 "Let me start by exploring the workspace and understanding the task." → step 19 "Let me explore the workspace structure."
- Step 16 spends 4,672 characters deriving the complete spec ("Now I have the full test file… The test file: - imports `CsvError`, `escapeField`, `parse`, `stringify`…"), and step 17 re-reads `src/csv.js`. That derivation was never sent back.
- The "truncated" complaints are the same symptom: step 15's "Interesting! The test file got truncated." follows a **complete** 8,778-byte result ending `203: }); … (End of file - total 203 lines)`. The model is not seeing a truncated result; it is seeing a result for a call it cannot remember making.
- Context is **not** being dropped: prompt tokens grow monotonically (7.4k → 11.2k → 16.5k → 34.3k → 39.1k by step 20). The history is present; only the reasoning inside it is inert.

Same pattern in `or-smoke-t2`: `code:glob-match` (42 steps, 36 reasoning blocks / 47,842 chars, 5 of 30 text blocks non-empty, 0 writes) and `code:path-normalize` (45 steps, 43 reasoning blocks / 67,793 chars, 7 of 26 text blocks non-empty, 0 writes).

Nemotron `or-h2-free-t2/cell-QRDjcb`, same task: **0 reasoning blocks**, 33 of 33 text blocks non-empty, tools `bash 17 / read 4 / write 4 / edit 8`.

The certified Claude Code cells (`data/proving-ground/2026-09-07-bench-h1-harness-loop-t2/sessions/*.jsonl`) also carry **0 reasoning blocks** and non-empty text, so they never exercise this path — which is why the defect survived certification.

### 4. Why Nemotron does not reason at all (the contrast is not luck)

Resolving the bench overlay's route through the real code (`resolveRouteModels`, run keylessly):

```
{"id":"deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731:free","api":"openai-completions","baseUrl":"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1","reasoning":false}
{"id":"nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free","api":"openai-completions","baseUrl":"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1","reasoning":true,"compat":{"supportsDeveloperRole":false,"thinkingFormat":"openrouter"}}
```

`deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731:free` is **absent** from pi-ai 0.82.1's installed OpenRouter catalog (which carries `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`, but not the dated `:free` id). `catalog.ts:327` therefore resolves `reasoning: base?.reasoning ?? false`, and `resolveModelCompat` returns `{}`. Consequences:

- `model.reasoning === false` ⇒ pi-ai's `thinkingFormat === "openrouter" && model.reasoning` guard fails ⇒ **no reasoning parameter is sent at all** ⇒ OpenRouter's default applies ⇒ the model thinks.
- Nemotron *is* in the catalog, so `model.reasoning === true`, no effort is requested, its entry has no `thinkingLevelMap`, and pi-ai takes the `else if (model.thinkingLevelMap?.off !== null)` branch and sends **`reasoning: { effort: "none" }`** — the harness silently turns Nemotron's thinking **off**. That is exactly why it narrates in `content`.

So the working model is the one whose reasoning is disabled. This is the trigger, not the root cause.

---

## Exact code path

**Harness — faithful, not at fault:**

- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts:197` — `replayState: toPiReplayState(event.message)`.
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/replay.ts:79-83` — records `thinkingSignature` (`"reasoning"` here) and `redacted`; `:84-87` records `thoughtSignature`.
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/replay.ts:174-179` — `replayedAssistant` restores `{ type: 'thinking', thinking, thinkingSignature }`.
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/context.ts:99 / :159` — `toPiAssistant(message)` goes into `PiContext.messages`.

**Harness — the actual gap:**

- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts:194-199` — `PiAiCompatProfile` exposes only `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`.
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts:388-419` — `resolveModelCompat` passes only those two through, and inherits `base.compat` only when the id is in the installed catalog (it is not).
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts:188-191` — `compatProfile` schema, same two fields.
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.md:90` — "The rest of pi-ai's compat surface … stays auto-detected and is deliberately not configurable here."

**pi-ai 0.82.1, `dist/api/openai-completions.js`:**

- `:353-370` — ingest: first non-empty of `["reasoning_content","reasoning","reasoning_text"]` becomes a `thinking` block whose `thinkingSignature` is that field name.
- `:82-92` + `:408-421` — `reasoning_details` are kept **only** when `type === "reasoning.encrypted"`, attached to the matching tool call as `thoughtSignature`. Plaintext `reasoning.text` details — which is what this endpoint returns — are **discarded**.
- `:836` — `assistantMsg = { role: "assistant", content: null }`.
- `:848-850` — thinking blocks that survive `trim()`.
- `:852-857` — `if (compat.requiresThinkingAsText)` → thinking goes into `content` as an array. **Not reachable from this repository.**
- `:868-875` — otherwise `assistantMsg[signature] = …`, i.e. **`assistantMsg.reasoning = "<thinking>"`** — the field OpenRouter ignores.
- `:906-922` — `reasoning_details` is rebuilt **only** from `thoughtSignature`, so a plaintext-reasoning provider gets none.
- `:1147-1180` — `detectCompat`: for `provider === "openrouter"`, `requiresThinkingAsText: false`, `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: false` (that one is `isDeepSeek`, which tests the *provider/baseURL*, never the model id).

Net wire shape sent on step N>1 today:

```json
{"role":"assistant","content":null,"reasoning":"<the whole plan>","tool_calls":[…]}
```

`content: null`, and `reasoning` is inert. The model sees a turn in which it said nothing.

---

## Fix proposal (not implemented)

### Primary — expose `requiresThinkingAsText` as a route/model compat switch

1. **`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts`** — add to `PiAiCompatProfile` (line 194-199):
   ```ts
   /** Whether the endpoint drops reasoning fields on input assistant messages, so a prior step's reasoning must be replayed inside `content`. */
   requiresThinkingAsText?: boolean
   ```
   and thread it through `resolveModelCompat` (line 388-419) exactly as `thinkingFormat` is threaded: read `entry.compat?.requiresThinkingAsText ?? route?.requiresThinkingAsText`, include it in the `undefined && undefined` early-return guard at line 397, and spread it into the returned `compat`.
2. **`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts:188-191`** — add `requiresThinkingAsText: z.boolean()` to `compatProfile`.
3. **`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.md:88-90`** — document the third switch and why it cannot be auto-detected: a gateway's baseURL says which *dialect* it speaks, not whether the *upstream model's* reasoning survives a round trip through it. Also relax the "deliberately not configurable" sentence at line 90.
4. **Bench overlay** `examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/proving-ground-bench/overlays/with-openrouter.cordis.yml` — on the DeepSeek entry (and any other reasoning model on the route):
   ```yaml
   - id: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731:free
     name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 (free)
     contextWindow: 1048576
     maxTokens: 393216
     compat:
       requiresThinkingAsText: true
   ```
   A route-level `compat.requiresThinkingAsText: true` would be a reasonable alternative, since every model on this route is served by OpenRouter.

Effect: pi-ai takes the `:852-857` branch and sends `content: [{type:"text", text:"<prior reasoning>"}, …]`. Live probe **V** confirms the model then acts on its prior plan on this exact model.

### Variant, if the array-form `content` is judged risky

pi-ai's own comment at `:858-863` warns that array `content` makes some DeepSeek-family deployments (V3.2 via NVIDIA NIM) mirror the block structure literally. Probe V did **not** reproduce that on this endpoint, but if the risk is unacceptable, put the decision in the harness instead: under the same config flag, have `replay.ts`'s `replayedAssistant`/`foreignAssistant` project a harness `reasoning` block into a pi-ai `{ type: 'text' }` block rather than `{ type: 'thinking' }`. pi-ai then sees only text blocks and emits a plain-string `content` (probe **Y**'s exact shape, which also passed). Cost: one flag threaded `adapter.ts` → `toPiContext` → `toPiAssistant`. Benefit: stays in the OpenAI standard string form pi-ai itself prefers, and keeps the decision in the package that owns the replay projection.

Whichever is chosen, keep it a validated `Config` field — per `AGENTS.md`, "No hardcoded tunables in plugins" — not a constant keyed off `provider === 'openrouter'`.

### Things that are *not* the fix

- **Re-sending `reasoning_details`.** Probe **B** shows OpenRouter did not feed a `reasoning.text` detail back to the model, and pi-ai cannot produce one anyway (`:82-92`, `:408-421` keep only encrypted details). No `compat` override helps.
- **Disabling thinking** via `reasoningEfforts: { off: null, high: 'high' }` (which would make pi-ai send `reasoning: {effort:"none"}`, confirmed by probe **W2** to suppress reasoning). On a fresh first turn with thinking off this model emitted `content: null` and no narration at all — it would be *more* amnesiac, and weaker.
- **Switching the overlay to the catalog id `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`.** It would inherit `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: true` and a `thinkingLevelMap` with no `off` key, so pi-ai would send `reasoning: {effort:"none"}` — the Nemotron treatment. That changes the failure, not the defect.

---

## How to test it keyless

**Unit / serialization (the regression pin).** `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/adapter.spec.ts` already asserts on captured request bodies via `mockServer` (`server.requests[0]`, lines 104, 122, 546, 592, 629, 660). Add a pair, so the behavior is pinned in both directions:

- *with the switch*: a hand-declared route whose model sets `compat: { requiresThinkingAsText: true }`; history = user message, assistant message carrying a `reasoning` block + a `tool-call` block with a matching `replayState` (`blocks: [{type:'reasoning', thinkingSignature:'reasoning'}, {type:'tool-call'}]`), then the tool result. Assert the captured assistant message has the reasoning text inside `content` and **no** top-level `reasoning` key.
- *without it*: the same history asserts `{ content: null, reasoning: '<text>' }` — this is the assertion that would have caught the bug, and it documents why the switch exists.

**Conversion layer** (only if the `replay.ts` variant is chosen): `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts` already builds `thinking`/`thinkingSignature` fixtures at lines 343-409; assert `toPiContext` emits a `text` block instead of a `thinking` block under the flag.

**Replay of a recorded session.** The three DeepSeek session logs in the scratch bench runs are usable as fixtures: feed each `assistant/message` (content + `source.replayState`) through `toPiContext` and assert that every reasoning block's text appears in the serialized assistant `content`. This exercises real recorded replay state rather than a hand-built one.

**Snapshot.** This changes a model-visible input, so `AGENTS.md` requires a keyless snapshot through a real runnable example in the same PR (`pnpm run test:snapshot`); the snapshot harness needs to be able to compose a route carrying the new compat switch, and that support belongs in the same change.

**Agent Note.** Non-trivial and cross-package; needs one under `.agents/notes/`.

---

## What I could not verify

- **Whether OpenRouter ever honors `reasoning_details` on input.** I tested `type: "reasoning.text"` echoed byte-for-byte from a real response of this model (probe B) — it did not come back. This endpoint never produced a `reasoning.encrypted` detail, so I could not test that type, and the result may differ for other providers/models behind OpenRouter.
- **Whether the bench run's raw SSE carried `reasoning_details`.** The session log stores pi-ai's normalized chunks only, so it is unobservable from the evidence. My probe responses all carried `reasoning_details: [{type:"reasoning.text", format:"unknown", …}]`, so it almost certainly did, and pi-ai discarded them at `:411`.
- **Whether the fix makes a bench cell pass.** I did not run a full cell (it would cost 25-40 requests against the free-tier daily allowance). Probes X/Y/V establish the per-step behavior change, not the end-to-end outcome.
- **Whether the other free models on the route (Qwen 3.8, Gemma 4, Laguna, Nex N2.5, Inkling) are affected.** Any of them that narrates in `reasoning` will be; I tested only the DeepSeek id.
- **Whether array-form `content` is safe for every step of a long run.** Probe V passed on one call; pi-ai's own comment records a counter-example on a different deployment.
- **The `code:path-normalize` cell may still have been running** when I read it; its 45 steps are consistent with the other two but might not be final.

---

## Reproduction artifacts

In this scratch directory (no credentials in any of them; no `Authorization` header was ever written to disk):

- `mkbodies.py`, `body-*.json` — the twelve request bodies.
- `resp-*.json` — the raw responses.
- `transcript.py`, `ds-transcript.txt` — the readable DeepSeek cell transcript.
- `resolve-check.ts` — the keyless `resolveRouteModels` check that produced the `reasoning: false` / no-`compat` finding.

Probe legend: A/B/C/D = codeword replay; E/F/G/H = trivial two-step tool loop (all four succeeded — too easy to discriminate); X/Y = plan-retention (the decisive behavioral pair); V = array-form content; W/W2 = fresh turn with thinking on/off; Z = `effort: none` with the plan in reasoning.

- Context is **not** being dropped: prompt tokens grow monotonically (7.4k → 11.2k → 16.5k → 34.3k → 39.1k by step 20). The history is present; only the reasoning inside it is inert.

Same pattern in `or-smoke-t2`: `code:glob-match` (42 steps, 36 reasoning blocks / 47,842 chars, 5 of 30 text blocks non-empty, 0 writes) and `code:path-normalize` (45 steps, 43 reasoning blocks / 67,793 chars, 7 of 26 text blocks non-empty, 0 writes).

Nemotron `or-h2-free-t2/cell-QRDjcb`, same task: **0 reasoning blocks**, 33 of 33 text blocks non-empty, tools `bash 17 / read 4 / write 4 / edit 8`.

The certified Claude Code cells (`data/proving-ground/2026-09-07-bench-h1-harness-loop-t2/sessions/*.jsonl`) also carry **0 reasoning blocks** and non-empty text, so they never exercise this path — which is why the defect survived certification.

### 4. Why Nemotron does not reason at all (the contrast is not luck)

Resolving the bench overlay's route through the real code (`resolveRouteModels`, run keylessly):

```
{"id":"deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731:free","api":"openai-completions","baseUrl":"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1","reasoning":false}
{"id":"nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free","api":"openai-completions","baseUrl":"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1","reasoning":true,"compat":{"supportsDeveloperRole":false,"thinkingFormat":"openrouter"}}
```

`deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731:free` is **absent** from pi-ai 0.82.1's installed OpenRouter catalog (which carries `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`, but not the dated `:free` id). `catalog.ts:327` therefore resolves `reasoning: base?.reasoning ?? false`, and `resolveModelCompat` returns `{}`. Consequences:

- `model.reasoning === false` ⇒ pi-ai's `thinkingFormat === "openrouter" && model.reasoning` guard fails ⇒ **no reasoning parameter is sent at all** ⇒ OpenRouter's default applies ⇒ the model thinks.
- Nemotron *is* in the catalog, so `model.reasoning === true`, no effort is requested, its entry has no `thinkingLevelMap`, and pi-ai takes the `else if (model.thinkingLevelMap?.off !== null)` branch and sends **`reasoning: { effort: "none" }`** — the harness silently turns Nemotron's thinking **off**. That is exactly why it narrates in `content`.

So the working model is the one whose reasoning is disabled. This is the trigger, not the root cause.

---

## Exact code path

**Harness — faithful, not at fault:**

- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts:197` — `replayState: toPiReplayState(event.message)`.
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/replay.ts:79-83` — records `thinkingSignature` (`"reasoning"` here) and `redacted`; `:84-87` records `thoughtSignature`.
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/replay.ts:174-179` — `replayedAssistant` restores `{ type: 'thinking', thinking, thinkingSignature }`.
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/context.ts:99 / :159` — `toPiAssistant(message)` goes into `PiContext.messages`.

**Harness — the actual gap:**

- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts:194-199` — `PiAiCompatProfile` exposes only `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`.
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts:388-419` — `resolveModelCompat` passes only those two through, and inherits `base.compat` only when the id is in the installed catalog (it is not).
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts:188-191` — `compatProfile` schema, same two fields.
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.md:90` — "The rest of pi-ai's compat surface … stays auto-detected and is deliberately not configurable here."

**pi-ai 0.82.1, `dist/api/openai-completions.js`:**

- `:353-370` — ingest: first non-empty of `["reasoning_content","reasoning","reasoning_text"]` becomes a `thinking` block whose `thinkingSignature` is that field name.
- `:82-92` + `:408-421` — `reasoning_details` are kept **only** when `type === "reasoning.encrypted"`, attached to the matching tool call as `thoughtSignature`. Plaintext `reasoning.text` details — which is what this endpoint returns — are **discarded**.
- `:836` — `assistantMsg = { role: "assistant", content: null }`.
- `:848-850` — thinking blocks that survive `trim()`.
- `:852-857` — `if (compat.requiresThinkingAsText)` → thinking goes into `content` as an array. **Not reachable from this repository.**
- `:868-875` — otherwise `assistantMsg[signature] = …`, i.e. **`assistantMsg.reasoning = "<thinking>"`** — the field OpenRouter ignores.
- `:906-922` — `reasoning_details` is rebuilt **only** from `thoughtSignature`, so a plaintext-reasoning provider gets none.
- `:1147-1180` — `detectCompat`: for `provider === "openrouter"`, `requiresThinkingAsText: false`, `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: false` (that one is `isDeepSeek`, which tests the *provider/baseURL*, never the model id).

Net wire shape sent on step N>1 today:

```json
{"role":"assistant","content":null,"reasoning":"<the whole plan>","tool_calls":[…]}
```

`content: null`, and `reasoning` is inert. The model sees a turn in which it said nothing.

---

## Fix proposal (not implemented)

### Primary — expose `requiresThinkingAsText` as a route/model compat switch

1. **`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts`** — add to `PiAiCompatProfile` (line 194-199):
   ```ts
   /** Whether the endpoint drops reasoning fields on input assistant messages, so a prior step's reasoning must be replayed inside `content`. */
   requiresThinkingAsText?: boolean
   ```
   and thread it through `resolveModelCompat` (line 388-419) exactly as `thinkingFormat` is threaded: read `entry.compat?.requiresThinkingAsText ?? route?.requiresThinkingAsText`, include it in the `undefined && undefined` early-return guard at line 397, and spread it into the returned `compat`.
2. **`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts:188-191`** — add `requiresThinkingAsText: z.boolean()` to `compatProfile`.
3. **`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.md:88-90`** — document the third switch and why it cannot be auto-detected: a gateway's baseURL says which *dialect* it speaks, not whether the *upstream model's* reasoning survives a round trip through it. Also relax the "deliberately not configurable" sentence at line 90.
4. **Bench overlay** `examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/proving-ground-bench/overlays/with-openrouter.cordis.yml` — on the DeepSeek entry (and any other reasoning model on the route):
   ```yaml
   - id: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731:free
     name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 (free)
     contextWindow: 1048576
     maxTokens: 393216
     compat:
       requiresThinkingAsText: true
   ```
   A route-level `compat.requiresThinkingAsText: true` would be a reasonable alternative, since every model on this route is served by OpenRouter.

Effect: pi-ai takes the `:852-857` branch and sends `content: [{type:"text", text:"<prior reasoning>"}, …]`. Live probe **V** confirms the model then acts on its prior plan on this exact model.

### Variant, if the array-form `content` is judged risky

pi-ai's own comment at `:858-863` warns that array `content` makes some DeepSeek-family deployments (V3.2 via NVIDIA NIM) mirror the block structure literally. Probe V did **not** reproduce that on this endpoint, but if the risk is unacceptable, put the decision in the harness instead: under the same config flag, have `replay.ts`'s `replayedAssistant`/`foreignAssistant` project a harness `reasoning` block into a pi-ai `{ type: 'text' }` block rather than `{ type: 'thinking' }`. pi-ai then sees only text blocks and emits a plain-string `content` (probe **Y**'s exact shape, which also passed). Cost: one flag threaded `adapter.ts` → `toPiContext` → `toPiAssistant`. Benefit: stays in the OpenAI standard string form pi-ai itself prefers, and keeps the decision in the package that owns the replay projection.

Whichever is chosen, keep it a validated `Config` field — per `AGENTS.md`, "No hardcoded tunables in plugins" — not a constant keyed off `provider === 'openrouter'`.

### Things that are *not* the fix

- **Re-sending `reasoning_details`.** Probe **B** shows OpenRouter did not feed a `reasoning.text` detail back to the model, and pi-ai cannot produce one anyway (`:82-92`, `:408-421` keep only encrypted details). No `compat` override helps.
- **Disabling thinking** via `reasoningEfforts: { off: null, high: 'high' }` (which would make pi-ai send `reasoning: {effort:"none"}`, confirmed by probe **W2** to suppress reasoning). On a fresh first turn with thinking off this model emitted `content: null` and no narration at all — it would be *more* amnesiac, and weaker.
- **Switching the overlay to the catalog id `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`.** It would inherit `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: true` and a `thinkingLevelMap` with no `off` key, so pi-ai would send `reasoning: {effort:"none"}` — the Nemotron treatment. That changes the failure, not the defect.

---

## How to test it keyless

**Unit / serialization (the regression pin).** `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/adapter.spec.ts` already asserts on captured request bodies via `mockServer` (`server.requests[0]`, lines 104, 122, 546, 592, 629, 660). Add a pair, so the behavior is pinned in both directions:

- *with the switch*: a hand-declared route whose model sets `compat: { requiresThinkingAsText: true }`; history = user message, assistant message carrying a `reasoning` block + a `tool-call` block with a matching `replayState` (`blocks: [{type:'reasoning', thinkingSignature:'reasoning'}, {type:'tool-call'}]`), then the tool result. Assert the captured assistant message has the reasoning text inside `content` and **no** top-level `reasoning` key.
- *without it*: the same history asserts `{ content: null, reasoning: '<text>' }` — this is the assertion that would have caught the bug, and it documents why the switch exists.

**Conversion layer** (only if the `replay.ts` variant is chosen): `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts` already builds `thinking`/`thinkingSignature` fixtures at lines 343-409; assert `toPiContext` emits a `text` block instead of a `thinking` block under the flag.

**Replay of a recorded session.** The three DeepSeek session logs in the scratch bench runs are usable as fixtures: feed each `assistant/message` (content + `source.replayState`) through `toPiContext` and assert that every reasoning block's text appears in the serialized assistant `content`. This exercises real recorded replay state rather than a hand-built one.

**Snapshot.** This changes a model-visible input, so `AGENTS.md` requires a keyless snapshot through a real runnable example in the same PR (`pnpm run test:snapshot`); the snapshot harness needs to be able to compose a route carrying the new compat switch, and that support belongs in the same change.

**Agent Note.** Non-trivial and cross-package; needs one under `.agents/notes/`.

---

## What I could not verify

- **Whether OpenRouter ever honors `reasoning_details` on input.** I tested `type: "reasoning.text"` echoed byte-for-byte from a real response of this model (probe B) — it did not come back. This endpoint never produced a `reasoning.encrypted` detail, so I could not test that type, and the result may differ for other providers/models behind OpenRouter.
- **Whether the bench run's raw SSE carried `reasoning_details`.** The session log stores pi-ai's normalized chunks only, so it is unobservable from the evidence. My probe responses all carried `reasoning_details: [{type:"reasoning.text", format:"unknown", …}]`, so it almost certainly did, and pi-ai discarded them at `:411`.
- **Whether the fix makes a bench cell pass.** I did not run a full cell (it would cost 25-40 requests against the free-tier daily allowance). Probes X/Y/V establish the per-step behavior change, not the end-to-end outcome.
- **Whether the other free models on the route (Qwen 3.8, Gemma 4, Laguna, Nex N2.5, Inkling) are affected.** Any of them that narrates in `reasoning` will be; I tested only the DeepSeek id.
- **Whether array-form `content` is safe for every step of a long run.** Probe V passed on one call; pi-ai's own comment records a counter-example on a different deployment.
- **The `code:path-normalize` cell may still have been running** when I read it; its 45 steps are consistent with the other two but might not be final.

---

## Reproduction artifacts

In this scratch directory (no credentials in any of them; no `Authorization` header was ever written to disk):

- `mkbodies.py`, `body-*.json` — the twelve request bodies.
- `resp-*.json` — the raw responses.
- `transcript.py`, `ds-transcript.txt` — the readable DeepSeek cell transcript.
- `resolve-check.ts` — the keyless `resolveRouteModels` check that produced the `reasoning: false` / no-`compat` finding.

Probe legend: A/B/C/D = codeword replay; E/F/G/H = trivial two-step tool loop (all four succeeded — too easy to discriminate); X/Y = plan-retention (the decisive behavioral pair); V = array-form content; W/W2 = fresh turn with thinking on/off; Z = `effort: none` with the plan in reasoning.

# DeepSeek loops on the OpenRouter bench route: prior-step reasoning never reaches the model

## Verdict

**Root cause: on this route the model's entire per-step deliberation lives in the `reasoning` channel, and nothing in that channel survives the round trip.** pi-ai serializes a prior step's thinking block as a plain `reasoning` string field on the assistant message; OpenRouter drops that field on input. The model wakes at every step with its own tool calls and tool results but no memory of the plan that produced them, and restarts the investigation. `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731:free` puts essentially 100% of its narration in `reasoning` (its `content` is literally a single space), so it loses everything. `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free` on the same route emits **zero** reasoning blocks and narrates in `content`, which is replayed intact — which is why it writes and edits.

The defect is **fixable in this repository**: the harness's `PiAiCompatProfile` does not expose pi-ai's `compat.requiresThinkingAsText`, the switch that moves replayed reasoning into `content`. pi-ai is not broken — it does what an unconfigured `openai-completions` route says to do. The model is not broken either: given the identical history with the plan in `content`, it acts correctly on the first try.

Hypothesis 1 is **confirmed in substance but not in the form stated**: the harness does *not* drop a signature. `stream.ts` → `toPiReplayState` preserves `thinkingSignature`/`thoughtSignature` faithfully and `replay.ts` → `replayedAssistant` restores them. The loss happens one layer up (pi-ai ingests only *encrypted* `reasoning_details`) and one layer down (OpenRouter ignores the `reasoning` field pi-ai re-sends).

Hypothesis 2 is answered: reasoning *is* produced and recorded. The `assistant/message` events carry full `reasoning` blocks matching the `reasoning-delta` chunk stream byte for byte. Hypothesis 3 is ruled out: system prompt, tool schemas and the line-numbered `<content>` wrapper are identical to the certified Claude Code route, tool results are complete (`(End of file - total 203 lines)` present), and prompt tokens grow monotonically, so no history is being dropped.

---

## Evidence

### 1. Live, decisive: the reasoning channel is write-only (12 requests total)

Same three-message conversation each time; the assistant's prior turn "decided" the codeword `ZEBRA-7741`, placed in a different channel per variant; the user then asks for it back.

| # | prior turn carries the secret in | model's answer |
|---|---|---|
| A | `reasoning: "<text>"` (**exactly what pi-ai sends**) | `UNKNOWN` |
| B | `reasoning_details: [{type:"reasoning.text", …}]` (OpenRouter's documented replay form, echoed byte-for-byte from a real response of this model) | `UNKNOWN` |
| C | `content: "<text>"` | `ZEBRA-7741` |
| D | nothing (negative control) | `UNKNOWN` |

**Only `content` reaches the model.** Neither field pi-ai can emit does.

### 2. Live, behavioral: the loop reproduces on one variable

Four-message agent conversation (harness-shaped system prompt, the csv-codec task, an assistant step whose plan is "I already read the spec in full; my very next action must be `write` on src/csv.js; I must not read those files again", a `read package.json` tool call, and its result). Only the channel of that plan differs.

| # | plan in | next action |
|---|---|---|
| X | `reasoning` (**what the harness sends today**) | `read {"file_path":"test/csv.test.js"}` ← **the bench loop, reproduced** |
| Y | `content` | `write {"file_path":"src/csv.js","content":"export class CsvError extends Error {…"}` ← **correct** |
| V | `content` as an array `[{type:"text",…}]` (pi-ai's `requiresThinkingAsText` form) | `write` — correct, no block-structure mirroring |

Same model, same tools, `temperature: 0`, `seed: 1`, same history bytes except the field name.

### 3. Session logs agree

`or-h2-free-t2/.sessions/…cell-Ze8JlA…/environment-9ff6535c-…/session.jsonl` (DeepSeek, `code:csv-codec`, 39 steps, 24 bash / 23 read / 0 write / 0 edit):

- Every assistant message carries a `reasoning` block with `replayState.blocks[i].thinkingSignature === "reasoning"`; **no** tool-call block ever carries a `thoughtSignature`.
- Text blocks are `" "` — a single space — on 16 of 39 steps and absent on the rest; only ~5 steps in the whole run have text surviving a `trim()`.
- Restarts are verbatim: step 1 "Let me start by exploring the workspace to understand the structure." → step 11 "Let me start by exploring the workspace and understanding the task." → step 19 "Let me explore the workspace structure."
- Step 16 spends 4,672 characters deriving the complete spec ("Now I have the full test file… - imports `CsvError`, `escapeField`, `parse`, `stringify`…"); step 17 re-reads `src/csv.js`. That derivation was never sent back.
- The "truncated" complaints are the same symptom: step 15's "Interesting! The test file got truncated." follows a **complete** 8,778-byte result ending `203: }); … (End of file - total 203 lines)`. The model is not seeing a truncated result; it is seeing a result for a call it cannot remember making.
- History is **not** being dropped: prompt tokens grow monotonically (7.4k → 11.2k → 16.5k → 34.3k → 39.1k by step 20).

Same pattern in `or-smoke-t2`: `code:glob-match` (42 steps, 36 reasoning blocks / 47,842 chars, 5 of 30 text blocks non-empty, 0 writes) and `code:path-normalize` (45 steps, 43 reasoning blocks / 67,793 chars, 7 of 26 non-empty, 0 writes).

Nemotron `cell-QRDjcb`, same task: **0 reasoning blocks**, 33 of 33 text blocks non-empty, tools `bash 17 / read 4 / write 4 / edit 8`. The certified Claude Code cells in `/home/user/deepseek-harness/data/proving-ground/2026-09-07-bench-h1-harness-loop-t2/sessions/` also carry **0 reasoning blocks** and non-empty text — which is why this defect survived certification.

```

```

Net wire shape on step N>1 today:

```json
{"role":"assistant","content":null,"reasoning":"<the whole plan>","tool_calls":[…]}
```

`content: null`, and `reasoning` is inert. The model sees a turn in which it said nothing.

## Fix proposal (not implemented)

### Primary — expose `requiresThinkingAsText` as a route/model compat switch

1. **`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts`** — add to `PiAiCompatProfile` (lines 194-199):
   ```ts
   /** Whether the endpoint drops reasoning fields on input assistant messages, so a prior step's reasoning must be replayed inside `content`. */
   requiresThinkingAsText?: boolean
   ```
   Thread it through `resolveModelCompat` (lines 388-419) exactly as `thinkingFormat` is threaded: read `entry.compat?.requiresThinkingAsText ?? route?.requiresThinkingAsText`, include it in the early-return guard at line 397, and spread it into the returned `compat`.
2. **`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts:188-191`** — add `requiresThinkingAsText: z.boolean()` to `compatProfile`.
3. **`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.md:88-90`** — document the third switch and why it cannot be auto-detected: a gateway's baseURL says which *dialect* it speaks, not whether the *upstream model's* reasoning survives a round trip through it. Relax the "deliberately not configurable" sentence at line 90.
4. **Bench overlay** `examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/proving-ground-bench/overlays/with-openrouter.cordis.yml` — on the DeepSeek entry (and any other reasoning model on the route):
   ```yaml
   - id: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731:free
     name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 (free)
     contextWindow: 1048576
     maxTokens: 393216
     compat:
       requiresThinkingAsText: true
   ```
   A route-level `compat.requiresThinkingAsText: true` is a reasonable alternative, since every model on this route is served by OpenRouter.

Effect: pi-ai takes the `:852-857` branch and sends `content: [{type:"text", text:"<prior reasoning>"}, …]`. Live probe **V** confirms the model then acts on its prior plan on this exact model.

### Variant, if the array-form `content` is judged risky

pi-ai's own comment at `:858-863` warns that array `content` makes some DeepSeek-family deployments (V3.2 via NVIDIA NIM) mirror the block structure literally. Probe V did **not** reproduce that here, but if the risk is unacceptable, put the decision in the harness: under the same config flag, have `replay.ts`'s `replayedAssistant`/`foreignAssistant` project a harness `reasoning` block into a pi-ai `{ type: 'text' }` block rather than `{ type: 'thinking' }`. pi-ai then sees only text blocks and emits a plain-string `content` — probe **Y**'s exact shape, which also passed. Cost: one flag threaded `adapter.ts` → `toPiContext` → `toPiAssistant`. Benefit: stays in the OpenAI standard string form pi-ai itself prefers, and keeps the decision in the package that owns the replay projection.

Either way, keep it a validated `Config` field — per `AGENTS.md`, "No hardcoded tunables in plugins" — not a constant keyed off `provider === 'openrouter'`.

### Things that are *not* the fix

- **Re-sending `reasoning_details`.** Probe **B** shows OpenRouter did not feed a `reasoning.text` detail back to the model, and pi-ai cannot produce one anyway (`:82-92`, `:408-421` keep only encrypted details). No `compat` override helps.
- **Disabling thinking** via `reasoningEfforts: { off: null, high: 'high' }` (which would make pi-ai send `reasoning: {effort:"none"}`; probe **W2** confirms that suppresses reasoning). On a fresh first turn with thinking off, this model emitted `content: null` and no narration at all — *more* amnesiac, and weaker.
- **Switching the overlay to the catalog id `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`.** It would inherit `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: true` and a `thinkingLevelMap` with no `off` key, so pi-ai would send `reasoning: {effort:"none"}` — the Nemotron treatment. Changes the failure, not the defect.

## How to test it keyless

**Unit / serialization (the regression pin).** `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/adapter.spec.ts` already asserts on captured request bodies via `mockServer` (`server.requests[0]` at lines 104, 122, 546, 592, 629, 660). Add a pair, pinning both directions:

- *with the switch*: a hand-declared route whose model sets `compat: { requiresThinkingAsText: true }`; history = user message, assistant message carrying a `reasoning` block plus a `tool-call` block with matching `replayState` (`blocks: [{type:'reasoning', thinkingSignature:'reasoning'}, {type:'tool-call'}]`), then the tool result. Assert the captured assistant message has the reasoning text inside `content` and **no** top-level `reasoning` key.
- *without it*: the same history asserts `{ content: null, reasoning: '<text>' }` — the assertion that would have caught this bug, and the one that documents why the switch exists.

**Conversion layer** (only for the `replay.ts` variant): `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts` already builds `thinking`/`thinkingSignature` fixtures at lines 343-409; assert `toPiContext` emits a `text` block instead of a `thinking` block under the flag.

**Replay of a recorded session log.** The three DeepSeek session logs in the scratch bench runs work as fixtures: feed each `assistant/message` (content + `source.replayState`) through `toPiContext` and assert every reasoning block's text appears in the serialized assistant `content`. This exercises real recorded replay state rather than a hand-built one.

**Snapshot.** This changes a model-visible input, so `AGENTS.md` requires a keyless snapshot through a real runnable example in the same PR (`pnpm run test:snapshot`); the snapshot harness needs to compose a route carrying the new compat switch, and that support belongs in the same change. A non-trivial cross-package change also needs an Agent Note under `.agents/notes/`.

## What I could not verify

- **Whether OpenRouter ever honors `reasoning_details` on input.** I tested `type: "reasoning.text"` echoed byte-for-byte from a real response of this model (probe B) — it did not come back. This endpoint never produced a `reasoning.encrypted` detail, so I could not test that type; other providers behind OpenRouter may differ.
- **Whether the bench run's raw SSE carried `reasoning_details`.** The session log stores pi-ai's normalized chunks only, so it is unobservable from the evidence. Every probe response carried `reasoning_details: [{type:"reasoning.text", format:"unknown", …}]`, so it almost certainly did, and pi-ai discarded them at `:411`.
- **Whether the fix makes a bench cell pass.** I did not run a full cell (25-40 requests against the free-tier daily allowance). Probes X/Y/V establish the per-step behavior change, not the end-to-end outcome.
- **Whether the other free models on the route** (Qwen 3.8, Gemma 4, Laguna, Nex N2.5, Inkling) are affected. Any that narrates in `reasoning` will be; I tested only the DeepSeek id.
- **Whether array-form `content` is safe across a long run.** Probe V passed on one call; pi-ai's own comment records a counter-example on a different deployment.
- **The `code:path-normalize` cell may still have been running** when I read it; its 45 steps are consistent with the other two but might not be final.
